body:
Calendar, Gantt and Board now read only when their actual query or planning revision changes. Identical startup routes and loaded-title filters no longer fetch the same page again. Real source invalidations, queued fresh follow-ups, current versions, paging, gestures and durability remain. Python stays outside ordinary browser/Rust request handling.

Quiet release M4 measurements with CPU ×4 and 100 ms latency improve dense Calendar filtering from 262 to 46 ms and clearing from 363 to 177 ms; Gantt filtering from 175 to 28 ms and Board clearing from 228 to 61 ms. All 168 measured selected filter actions make zero planning GETs, versus 154 in controls. Ordinary opening medians are broadly unchanged. The full gate passes 428 tests; release Chromium/WebKit cover start/filter behavior, current source versions, retained invalidations, planning, pagination, session recovery and timed events.

Application revision b1f9039 is rebuilt and running at the existing HTTPS origin. All 61 prior resource versions, two pins, preferences and certificate are preserved; all 33 served frontend assets are verified. Broader performance, dense whole-month rendering, other workloads and physical-device/remote-network acceptance remain open. Evidence: progress/2026-10-01-planning-read-scopes.md.

metadata.summary: Planning read scopes keep title filters local and remove redundant startup reads
